title: Code pattern front matter
description: Front matter of a file in patterns/. The name must also equal the filename without .md, which JSON Schema cannot express; test/consistency.sh checks it.

name.description: Kebab-case identifier, equal to the filename without .md.

applies_when.description: What kind of code the pattern is about, so a reviewer can skip patterns that do not apply.

smells.description: Signals that a violation is present; the reviewer's search list.

not_a_violation.description: Cases to leave alone, to keep the rubric from producing noise.
